protocol: Production WASM inference. Paced 50ms PCM chunks; timer includes capture duration from recording start, excludes microphone/BLE/display. Cold means saved weights/checks but unloaded workers. Shared desktop, single paired run per browser/clip; early text can be revised. Dictionary vocabulary comes from disjoint same-chapter excerpts; terms set selects a <=12s clip per speaker with the most hint occurrences. Not a broad/dedicated biomedical evaluation.
